➢ Game changing 2-component OBN for high quality shallow
water seismic acquisition down to 500m;
➢ All-in-one design supports either node-on-a-rope (NOAR) or
remotely-operated vehicle (ROV);
➢ Built-in 14Hz omnidirectional high sensitivity geophone;
➢ Optional 3Hz active force feedback geophone for broadband
seismic survey;
➢ Built-in standard 3.4Hz hydrophone;
➢ 24-bit Δ-Σ ADC converter for high resolution, high dynamic
range seismic signal recording;
➢ Configurable sample rate and preamplifier gain;
➢ Built-in test signal generator supports full signal chain
function and performance self-inspection;
➢ Built-in high precision thermostatic crystal (OCXO) for ±2ms
timing accuracy ;
➢ Compact volume (35L x 21W x 11H cm) and light weight
(11kg) for convenient deployment and retrieval.
